headline: Industry: the Cim plan to grow SMEs | 23 billion in added value over ten years. Here are the proposals
summary: A new plan aims to grow small and medium-sized enterprises, estimating added value of 23 billion over ten years. Proposals for the plan were also presented.
why: Small and medium-sized enterprises make up most of Italy's business base, so their growth affects employment and productivity.
